name: Bounding Volume {B}
definition: The ambient occlusion volume of P is bounded by k+2 planes. Planes {B_0,...,B_{k-1}} correspond to polygon edges, B_k is the plane above P, B_{k+1} contains P. Normals are $\hat{m}_i$. For max obscurance distance $\delta$, $B_i: \vec{x} \cdot (\vec{x}-\vec{p}_i) \cdot \hat{m}_i = \delta$, where $\vec{p}_k = \vec{p}_0$ and $\vec{p}_{k+1} = \vec{p}_0 + \delta \hat{m}_{k+1}$.
summary: The Bounding Volume {B} is a closed polyhedron that efficiently rasterizes ambient occlusion by explicitly computing displacement vectors to extrude polygon vertices into a 3D volume.
